Subject: Quick follow-up on the TigerLytics benchmark you downloaded

Hi Samir,

Thanks for downloading the TigerLytics benchmark from our site — I pulled your report and thought it would be useful to walk through a 20–30 minute demo focused on the cost/latency profiles for your workload. I’ve attached the version of the report we captured (TIGERLYTICS-BENCHMARK-REPORT.pdf) and a short one-pager on how teams typically get started with Redwood.

Two quick options:
- 30 min quick walkthrough (recommended) to validate the numbers and look at optimizations
- 45 min technical deep-dive if you'd like to include an infra/ML engineer

Are you available next week? Happy to send a calendar invite or you can pick a slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood/vivek-30

If you prefer, I can loop in Marissa (cc’d) from Solutions so she can demo the integration bits.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

1) We’re based on EST — your Calendly page showed PST slots and a couple of options overlapped with our standups. Can you propose times that align with 11am–3pm ET next week?
2) I’ll likely include our engineering lead (Priya) if we go technical; would you be okay extending to 45 minutes?

If you can throw over 2–3 windows that fit ET, I’ll pick one and confirm.

Thanks,

Hey Samir — great callout on timezones. Sorry for the confusion. Here are three ET windows next week that work on our side (I’ve proposed 45 minutes to cover the engineering questions):

- Tue 19 May — 11:30am–12:15pm ET
- Wed 20 May — 1:00pm–1:45pm ET
- Thu 21 May — 2:30pm–3:15pm ET

If any of those look good I’ll send a calendar invite and include Marissa for the product demo. Otherwise you can pick directly from this ET-friendly link: https://calendly.com/redwood/vivek-30?timezone=America%2FNew_York

Note: we’ll cover the benchmark highlights, recommended batching/quantization levers, and a short checklist of infra items (GPU types, token distribution) so Priya will get concrete next steps.

If you want me to include a short pre-call agenda I can drop that into the invite.

Thanks,
Vivek
